*Edited to fix an issue pointed out by @kashka below.*

----------

The snippet below improves the search label by:

* allowing the user to click the label to check the box * allowing you to customize the text of the label * vertically centering the label and checkbox to each other

You can see it in action at /v/Launcher.

Simply change the first part to say what you want.

~~~ /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/ /* Label text (this is all you need to change) /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/

#l + label::after { content: "Limit search to /v/Launcher"; }

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/ /* Base /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* Form container */ form[action="/search"] { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

/* Validation error */ .field-validation-error { display: block; width: 100%; height: 20px; }

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/ /* Checkboxes /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* Old checkbox */ /* This makes it an invisible, clickable overlay */ #l { position: absolute; z-index: 2; bottom: 0px; left: -4000px; width: 10000px; height: 30px; cursor: pointer; outline: none; }

/* New checkbox */ /* Using the icon font already built into Voat */ #l + label::before { font-family: "Glyphicons Halflings"; font-size: 16px; content: "e157"; }

#l:checked + label::before { content: "e067"; }

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/ /* Labels /*-------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* Old label */ #l + label { font-size: 0; }

/* New label */ #l + label::after { position: absolute; left: 20px; display: block; bottom: 0px; line-height: 30px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; }

#l:hover + label::after, #l:focus + label::after { text-decoration: underline; } ~~~
